name: Shei Shi Zhong Zhi Ren
source:
—Mr. C, CEO of world-famous VTuber Kuripa's agency, has been brutally murdered. Possible suspects have been whittled down to one of the agency's six employees, three of which claim to be Kuripa's "real face," saying they were streaming as Kuripa during Mr. C's murder—the perfect alibi! As Prosecutor Justin Truth, it is your job to uncover the lies and find Mr. C's killer!


[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2871140]Steam[/url]]
